rubric.why: Distance measures the total length of the path travelled.
rubric.description: Defines distance as the length of the path travelled.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying distance as the total length of the path travelled.

rubric.why: Displacement is the straight-line change from the initial to the final position and includes direction.
rubric.description: Defines displacement as the straight-line change in position with direction.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying displacement as a straight-line change in position and stating that it has direction.

modelAnswer: Distance is the total length of the actual path travelled; it is a scalar quantity.
Displacement is the shortest straight-line change from the initial to the final position and has direction; it is a vector quantity.

items.followUp: State Newton’s first law of motion.

accept: uniform motion in a straight line
rubric.why: The law states that a body maintains its state of rest or uniform straight-line motion.
rubric.description: Identifies the state of rest or uniform motion that a body maintains.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a body remains at rest or continues in uniform motion in a straight line.

accept: unless acted upon by an external force
rubric.why: A body changes its state only when compelled by an external force.
rubric.description: States that an external force is required to change the body's state.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning that the state changes only when an external force acts on the body.

modelAnswer: The law of inertia states that every body continues in its state of rest or uniform motion in a straight line unless acted upon by an external force.
